title: Special Topics - M.A. Level; Montage and Modern Life
description: Cross-listed with GERM689G. Credit only granted for GERM449G or GERM689G . This seminar explores the relationship between montage/collage artisti c practice and various conceptions of political art and literature in 20 thcentury Germany. Authors, artists, and filmmakers to be discussed include Adorno, Benjamin, Brecht, Heartfield, Hoch, Kluge, Ruttmann, Seghers, Vertov, and Weiss.
